0022600107.text: The Rockets (2-0, 1st in the Southwest) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast) in the third game of Houston's season, and Atlanta has yet to play at home. Fred VanVleet (knee) and Steven Adams (ankle) are out for Houston, while Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For Atlanta, Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after Houston won both games of the 2025-26 series, including a 117-95 win in Houston on March 20.
